h1: A shopping assistant that helps customers choose and compare
overview: Some shoppers leave because they cannot decide. We add an assistant to your store that asks a few simple questions, such as budget, use and preferences, then suggests products from your own catalog with a short reason for each. It can compare two items side by side and answer questions about sizes or materials. It recommends only products you actually sell and have in stock.

faq: Will it recommend products I do not sell?
No. It is limited to your catalog, and we test that it does not name other brands or invent products. In the higher packages it also checks stock before suggesting an item.
We build it to make choosing easier, and the top package tracks clicks and add to carts so you can see the effect. We cannot promise a particular sales increase.
What does it need to know about my products?
Good titles, descriptions, tags and prices. If your data is thin, we suggest a catalog enrichment pass first so recommendations have something to work from.
Where does the assistant appear on my site?
As a button on product and collection pages, or as a quiz style page you link from your menu. We agree the placement with you so it does not block checkout.
